hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qiE '(^|[;&|]|[[:space:]])rm[[:space:]]+(-[A-Za-z]*r[A-Za-z]*f[A-Za-z]*|-[A-Za-z]*f[A-Za-z]*r[A-Za-z]*|--recursive[[:space:]]+--force|--force[[:space:]]+--recursive)([[:space:]]|$)' || printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qiE '(^|[;&|]|[[:space:]])sudo([[:space:]]|$)' || printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qiE 'chmod[[:space:]]+(-[A-Za-z]+[[:space:]]+)?777([[:space:]]|$)' || printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qiE '(curl|wget)\b[^|;&]*\|[[:space:]]*(sudo[[:space:]]+)?(sh|bash|zsh)\b' || printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qiE '(bash|sh|zsh)[[:space:]]+<\([[:space:]]*(curl|wget)\b' || printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qiE 'git[[:space:]]+push\b.*(--force([^-]|$)|[[:space:]]-f([[:space:]]|$))' || printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qiE 'git[[:space:]]+reset\b.*--hard\b'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked by project policy: rm -rf, sudo, chmod 777, curl|wget piped into a shell, force-pushing, and hard resets are not allowed."}}'; fi
